messages:
june: Thanks for coming to the all-hands today. Posting follow-ups, links, and owners in one spot so nothing falls through. Please ack and update as you make progress.

maria: missed the last bit 1 can you share slides/recording?

june: slides + recording here: https://redwood.app/slides/all-hands-2026-03-23 and https://redwood.app/recordings/all-hands-2026-03-23. Internal roadmap: https://confluence.redwood/roadmap/Q2-2026.

june: Action/owner snapshot (please confirm dates):
- Public roadmap milestones & release dates -> aj (update by 2026-04-06)
- Dedicated GA checklist + perf targets -> samir (publish by 2026-05-03)
- Private deploy compliance package (KMS/HSM, audit hooks) -> lia (draft by 2026-04-20)
- Redwood Optimize beta playbook (batching, quant, caching) -> maria (draft by 2026-04-12)

aj: Quick note from the Q&A about rate-limits: default hosted limits unchanged. We'll add per-route throttle configs for high-throughput customers and update SDK examples. I'll open tracking doc + SDK PRs this week.

aj: SDK batching snippet we'll include in examples:
```
batching: {
  max_tokens_per_batch: 4096,
  preferred_latency_ms: 80
}
```

samir: Dedicated GA clarification: aiming for partner GA May 3rd. Target SLO: p95 < 120ms at 11k rps on 8xA100 pool. SRE: can you run perf harness on staging next week and share results? I'll put the benchmark writeup in the perf repo by 2026-04-10.

lia: For Private compliance checklist: collecting KMS/HSM patterns, audit log hooks, network diagrams. Need security review 1 @maria can you coordinate for first-pass review by 2026-04-18?

maria: yes, I'll coordinate with Security. Also will start quantization recommendations for Mistral and Llama families for the Optimize playbook.

aj: I'll add a short quantization/profiles section to the docs with expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

ops-bot: Created follow-up board: https://tasks.redwood/board/all-hands-followups-1942103347. Items auto-assigned per thread.

june: Clarifications from the Q&A thread: 1) No pricing change at Dedicated GA launch; pricing will be announced separately. 2) Dedicated customers can choose model pinning or opt into auto-minor-updates. 3) We'll run a public benchmark week post-GA 1 devx will publish signup.

maria: Support asked for a short troubleshooting doc for common integration errors (401, model-not-found, token quota). I'll prototype a gist and share.

aj: SDK changelog + migration guide will be updated; will post PRs by EOD Fri.

samir: SRE scheduled perf runs Tue/Wed; will post raw logs to perf repo and summary to the follow-up board. Ping me if you need harness access.

lia: Security review request created; adding network diagrams to the checklist.

june: Thanks 1 update this thread as you progress and mark items done on the board. If anything needs leadership decision, tag me. :thumbsup: 

maria: ack, added initial docs to the board.

aj: ack, will post PRs this week.

samir: ack, perf runs scheduled.

lia: ack, review requested from security.
